at: She takes a peach from a tray and does not bite it.
alt: Close on a ripe blush peach held at a woman's painted mouth at a lamplit banquet, its skin sucked glossy, a thick bead of juice running down to the wrist.
scene: Extreme close-up painted still at a lamplit banquet, shallow focus. A single ripe peach, fat and blushing rose-gold, held up in the frame by the tips of two fingers and a thumb, the cleft of the peach turned to camera. One side of its skin is sucked wet and glossy, the soft flesh just broken at the top so it gleams, a heavy bead of golden juice swelling at the lowest point and a thin wet line already run down over the knuckles to the inside of the wrist, where the frayed cuff of a washed-out green jeogori sleeve and a twist of red sash cloth just enter the frame. Nothing else of her. Behind, a blur of banquet lamps as warm bokeh and a lacquer tray of more peaches. ONE device: the bead of juice about to drop, lit like a jewel. Sage-green #8AAFA0 and rose-gold, warm lamp key.

at: She takes her time getting to the purple one
alt: A cheap clay wine cup filled past its brim on a banquet table, the wine swelling over and running down, a half-sucked peach leaking beside it.
scene: Close painted still on a plain wooden banquet table, low angle at table height, warm lamplight. A cheap unglazed clay wine cup filled PAST its brim, the dark wine domed above the rim by surface tension and just breaking over one side in a slow heavy run down the outside of the cup, pooling in a dark glossy ring on the wood. Beside the cup lies a ripe blush peach, half-sucked and set down on its side, its soft flesh open and wet, a slow trickle of golden juice running from it across the grain toward the wine until the two wet lines almost meet. A plain clay jug tilted at the frame edge, its lip still dripping. Hanging cheap paper lamps above as bokeh. ONE device: the swollen meniscus of the overfull cup. Sage-green #8AAFA0 shadow, ice-blue #7EB8F0 cold glint far behind.

at: sucks the last of the juice off it
alt: A half-eaten peach set down on a moonlit stone parapet, its juice running down the warm stone in one slow glistening line.
scene: Painted still on a fortress wall-walk at midnight, close on the top of a rough granite parapet, the river far below as soft silver bokeh under a full moon. A half-eaten ripe peach sits on the stone where it has just been set down, its bitten side turned up, flesh wet and gleaming, the stone at its heart just showing. Golden juice has pooled under it and runs over the edge of the parapet in one slow thick glistening line down the face of the warm stone, catching the moonlight the whole way down. A dropped shawl lies in a soft heap at the foot of the parapet. ONE device: the single line of juice running down the stone. Moon-silver, sage-green #8AAFA0 in the shadows, ice-blue #7EB8F0 rim on the wet.

at: A bowl of banquet peaches sits on the sill
alt: A bitten-open peach on a timber windowsill beside a small oil lamp, leaking juice down the wood all night.
scene: Painted still, close and low on a dark timber windowsill inside a fortress tower room at night. A small clay oil lamp burns low, its flame bent. Beside it a ripe peach lies bitten open, the soft gold flesh parted along its seam and swollen, juice welling out of it and running in a glossy dark rivulet across the sill and over its edge, dripping onto the floorboards in a slow string of beads. Behind it a lacquer bowl of whole peaches and, out of focus, the crumpled shape of a red sash thrown over a rumpled sleeping mat. Paper lattice window glowing faint moon-blue behind. ONE device: the dripping string of juice off the sill edge. Warm amber lamp key, ice-blue #7EB8F0 moonlight, red sash as the only hot colour.

at: the peach is only a stone
alt: At grey dawn, beside a cold lamp, all that is left of the peach is its stone in a dark sticky ring, a gold butterfly on the pillow behind.
scene: Painted still at grey dawn, close on a timber windowsill in a tower room. A cold clay oil lamp, the wick black and spent, a thin last thread of smoke. Beside it all that is left of the peach: the bare wrinkled peach stone sitting in the middle of a dark, dried, sticky ring that has run across the sill and dripped down over the edge in a stiff glossy tail. Out of focus behind, a rumpled pillow on an empty sleeping mat with a small hand-hammered gold butterfly pendant on a pink silk cord lying on it, catching the first light. Grey-blue light through the door slit. ONE device: the sticky ring around the stone. Cold grey-blue, ice-blue #7EB8F0, one gold glint.

at: The old green has been washed so thin it holds her like a hand
alt: At the banquet Maehwa leans in the lamplight sucking slowly on a peach, her thin old green jeogori clinging to her figure, while the young Guardian at the top table stares.
scene: Romance still, medium shot, low three-quarter angle across a lamplit banquet hall. Maehwa (thirty-one) stands in the foreground under the cheap hanging lamps, one hip cocked, in her old washed-thin green jeogori that clings to her full bust and the narrowest waist in the room, the frayed red sash cinched hard around it, the ochre chima pulled snug over her full curving hips. She holds a ripe blush peach to her lips and sucks it slowly, eyes heavy-lidded and sliding sideways to the top table, a slow knowing half-smile, a line of juice running to her wrist. Deep behind her, out of focus but readable, young Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, topknot, ice-blue silk robe) at the top table has gone still with his cup halfway to his mouth, flushed to the ears, staring. ONE device: the peach at her mouth catching the lamp. Sage-green #8AAFA0 on her, ice-blue #7EB8F0 on him. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers on Pumsuk.

at: She stands, shakes the shawl off her knees
alt: On the moonlit wall-walk Maehwa stands and stretches, arms up, her thin green jeogori pulled tight over her curves, while Pumsuk on the step below cannot look away.
scene: Romance still, low angle from the parapet step looking up, full figure. Midnight on the stone wall-walk, the moon behind her head as a halo, river below as silver bokeh. Maehwa (thirty-one) has just stood up and stretches slowly with both arms raised behind her head, back arched, the washed-thin old green jeogori pulled taut across her full bust, the red sash cinching her tiny waist, the ochre chima clinging to the curve of her hips as moonlight rims her whole hourglass silhouette; the shawl slides off at her feet. Her face tips down to him with a lazy, teasing half-smile, eyes half-closed. In the near foreground on the step below, young Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, topknot, ice-blue silk robe) sits frozen, lips parted, flushed, fists on his knees. On the parapet beside her, a half-eaten peach drips down the stone. ONE device: the moon rimming her silhouette. Sage-green #8AAFA0, ice-blue #7EB8F0 moonlight. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers on Pumsuk.

alt: Just inside his door Pumsuk holds Maehwa hard against him, his hands spread on the small of her back, while her hand finds the door bar behind them.
scene: Romance still, tight two-shot, medium-close, side angle just inside a dark tower-room door. Young Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, topknot coming loose, ice-blue silk robe pulled half open at the collar) holds Maehwa (thirty-one) crushed against him, both his hands spread wide on the small of her back below the cinched red sash, pulling her hips into his. Her old thin green jeogori clings to every curve as she arches into him, full bust pressed to his chest, her head tipped back, mouth an inch from his, eyes half-lidded and amused, one arm wound around his neck while her other hand reaches back behind them and slides the wooden door bar home before he can. A small cold oil lamp on the sill and a bowl of peaches beside it. ONE device: her hand on the door bar in sharp focus. Warm lamp key, sage-green #8AAFA0, ice-blue #7EB8F0. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers on Pumsuk.

at: She tips her mouth and asks whether the sun likes what it sees
alt: Waist-deep in the golden Amnok, Yuhwa in clinging wet ice-blue silk tips her mouth up to Haemosu as he pulls her against him.
scene: Romance still, medium two-shot at the waterline, low angle, golden hour. Waist-deep in the glassy Amnok river, Haemosu (gold sun-god, bare-headed, sun-gold robe soaked and plastered to his broad chest and shoulders) has one arm hooked around Yuhwa's waist and pulls her flush against him. Yuhwa, river-daughter, in her wet ice-blue silk clinging transparent-tight to her bust, waist and hips, the silk half slipping off one shoulder, wet hair down her back, tips her mouth up to his an inch away, eyes heavy and daring, one hand flat on his chest. River at their hips in gold-lit rings. ONE device: the low sun flaring gold between their almost-touching mouths. Gold #f0b429 on him, ice-blue #8fc4e0 on her.

at: He puts her back to it anyway.
alt: In the hot copper room Haemosu has Yuhwa pressed back against the glowing copper wall, her wet ice-blue silk gathered at her hip, her leg hooked around him.
scene: Romance still, tight two-shot, three-quarter angle inside a small copper-walled room glowing with trapped afternoon heat. Haemosu (gold sun-god, sun-gold robe open and soaked, broad wet chest) presses Yuhwa back against the hot copper wall, one forearm braced above her head, the other hand gripping her thigh. Yuhwa in wet ice-blue silk that clings to every curve, the silk gathered up at her hip, one bare leg hooked high around his waist, her head thrown back against the copper, eyes shut, lips parted, both hands clawed in his robe at his shoulders. A hard bar of gold light lies across their wet bodies. ONE device: her hand print smeared on the steamed copper beside her head. Gold #f0b429, ice-blue #8fc4e0, copper glow. Clothed, no nudity.

alt: At the morning well Jumong kisses Sosuno against the well-beam, her dusty-rose jeogori wet and clinging at the waist from the rope.
scene: Romance still, medium-close two-shot, low angle against the morning sky, beside a stone village well with a timber well-beam and hanging rope bucket. Young Jumong (rugged archer, bare-headed, red robe with the sleeves pushed up over strong forearms, broad back) has Sosuno backed against the well-beam and kisses her, one big hand at her jaw, the other at her waist. Sosuno (dusty-rose jeogori and skirt, the cloth soaked dark from the rope at her waist and clinging tight to her waist and hips) has rope still wound in one fist and the other hand fisted in his collar, kissing him back hard, ears pink. Water slops over the bucket lip and splashes the stones. ONE device: the over-full bucket spilling beside them. Red #e8563f on him, dusty-rose #e8a04a on her, cool morning light.

at: Then she is on his mouth like she is angry at it.
alt: In the dim grain room Sosuno drags Jumong down by the collar and kisses him like she is angry at it, both of them pressed against the stacked sacks.
scene: Romance still, tight two-shot, dramatic low angle in a dim grain store, slats of dusty daylight through the timber walls, stacked straw grain sacks rising behind. Sosuno (dusty-rose jeogori tight across her bust, skirt hiked and clinging to her hips) has one fist bunched in Jumong's collar and drags his mouth down to hers, kissing him fiercely, brows knit in fury and want, her other hand still balled against his chest where she hit him. Young Jumong (rugged archer, bare-headed, red robe half off one broad shoulder) catches her by the waist and lifts her back against the sacks, grain spilling from a split sack in a gold stream. ONE device: the stream of spilling grain in a shaft of light. Red #e8563f, dusty-rose #e8a04a, gold dust in the air.

at: He holds her with one arm. The other is cloud.
alt: On the mountain ridge Ibiga holds Right View against him with one arm while the other dissolves into cloud wrapping around her.
scene: Romance still, medium two-shot on a high jade mountain ridge in late afternoon, pines and cloud sea below. Ibiga, sky-god, holds Right View, mountain-goddess, tight against his chest with one strong arm around her waist; his other arm dissolves from the shoulder into a river of white cloud that coils around her hips and up her back like a second embrace. Right View in her canon robe worn thin and clinging to her curves, the silk slipping off one shoulder, leans back into him with her eyes closed and her mouth at his neck, one hand sliding up into his hair. ONE device: the cloud-arm wrapping her waist. Ultramarine #1e4d9c on him, violet #c084fc on her, low gold light.

at: He kneels. The cloud kneels with him
alt: In the mist of the ravine Ibiga kneels and wraps his arms around Right View's hips, his face pressed to her waist, while she holds his head and tips her face to the sky.
scene: Romance still, low-angle medium shot in a misty mountain ravine, dew on every leaf. Ibiga, sky-god, kneels in the wet moss and wraps both arms around Right View's hips, his face pressed against the clinging silk at her waist, cloud kneeling around him in soft folds. Right View, mountain-goddess, stands above him, her canon robe dew-soaked and clinging to her bust, waist and hips, both hands buried in his hair, head thrown back, eyes closed, lips parted toward the sky. A thin spring trickles bright over the rocks behind her. ONE device: the dew beading on her silk. Ultramarine #1e4d9c, violet #c084fc, green mist.

at: the walk stops being a walk
alt: At the darkest corner of the palace wall Suro kisses Heo's throat with her back against the wall, her thin purple silk clinging, her hand pulling him closer.
scene: Romance still, tight two-shot, three-quarter angle at the dark corner of an earthen palace wall at dusk, a single torch far down the wall. King Suro (purple silk robe with gold-ochre collar bands, little gold crown, broad shoulders) has Heo Hwang-ok pressed back against the wall and kisses her throat, one hand spread at her waist on the thin purple silk. Heo in her canon purple silk, salt-damp and clinging close to her bust, waist and hips, head tipped back against the wall, eyes half-closed with a sly smile, one hand gripping the back of his neck to keep him there, the other flat on the wall. ONE device: her fingers splayed on the rough wall. Amber #e0a33c light on him, violet-rose #d98fa8 on her, torch-warm key, blue dusk.

alt: By the lamp she has just lit, Suro pulls Heo against him from behind, his hands on her hips through the thin purple silk that the lamplight shines through.
scene: Romance still, medium-close, side angle in a tent lit by one oil lamp. Heo Hwang-ok has just lit the lamp and turned; King Suro (purple silk robe with gold-ochre collar bands loosened, little gold crown) comes up behind her and pulls her back against his chest, both hands on her hips. Heo in her thin canon purple silk, lamplight shining through it to outline the full curve of her hip and waist, leans her head back onto his shoulder, eyes heavy, lips parted, her hand over his on her hip, guiding it. ONE device: the lamp flame behind the silk making her silhouette glow. Amber #e0a33c, violet-rose #d98fa8, warm lamp key. Clothed, no nudity.

at: She stands behind him, needle forgotten
alt: Munhee wraps her arms around Chunchu from behind, her slipped magenta silk clinging, her mouth at the pulse of his neck, the needle forgotten in her hand.
scene: Romance still, medium-close, three-quarter angle in a lamplit sewing room, the half-mended coat on the floor. Kim Chunchu (young hwarang, coat off, thin inner robe over broad shoulders, bare-headed) sits very still, eyes closed. Munhee stands behind him with both arms wrapped around his chest, her magenta silk slipped off one shoulder and clinging tight to her bust and waist as she presses against his back, her mouth on the place above his pulse, a long thread and needle forgotten dangling from her fingers across his chest. ONE device: the thread drawn taut across his chest. Magenta #D8258C, pink #E07FA8, warm lamp.

at: He stays. The household learns the sound of a door
alt: Behind the closed door Chunchu lifts Munhee against him, her pink silk clinging, her legs around his waist, as the lamp gutters.
scene: Romance still, tight two-shot, low angle just inside a closed paper-lattice door at night. Kim Chunchu (young hwarang, bare-headed, magenta robe hanging open) has lifted Munhee off her feet against him, his hands under her thighs; Munhee in her pink silk, the skirt rucked up and clinging to her hips and waist, wraps her legs around him and her arms around his neck and kisses him deeply, her hair coming down. Their shadows on the paper door, a lamp guttering on the floor. ONE device: their joined shadow on the lattice door. Magenta #D8258C, pink #E07FA8, warm lamp, blue night through the paper. Clothed, no nudity.
